Game Overview

In The Last Ritual, the core idea is straightforward: step into the shoes of Daniel, a determined paranormal investigator, trapped in a treacherous mansion. Unravel the mystery of the three failed rituals, outsmart vengeful spirits, and rescue your sister from the clutches of the haunted hallways in this thrilling quest for survival.

Getting started in The Last Ritual doesn't take long to learn. Step into the shoes of Daniel, a determined paranormal investigator, trapped in a treacherous mansion.
